## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** pe_<slug> raw disc copy launched with launch_game mod=; no in-session swap proven

**Pick whip: none.** only the generic pick_identify slot guess (PS1 models diffed in RAM, VRAM textures not injected; never run live)

**Live controls:** none; frame_rip can rip the posed on-screen model to glTF (Windows, RenderDoc)

### RAM / runtime hooks (curated)

| hook | address | what | status | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| platform RAM access (PS1) | `main RAM offsets 0..0x1FFFFF` | RetroArch READ/WRITE_CORE_MEMORY; frame_rip reads with addr & 0x1FFFFF and can write NCLIP cull patches into a running core (psx_disable_cull, read back) | unverified | gbox/frame_rip.py |
| GTE projection H | `0x800BCFA8` | *(u32*)*(u32*)0x800BCFA8 = 323, the focal length frame_rip needs to unproject a RenderDoc capture | proven_read | gbox/frame_rip.py docstring |
| current outfit selector | `0x800B0CE2` | DAT_800b0ce2 - 10 picks the outfit blob pair | unverified | gbox/parasite_eve.py docstring (Ghidra) |

- enemy/NPC models in room packages (section C) have no writer
- no RAM pointer to the loaded Aya model, so no in-RAM swap
- textures are VRAM uploads, not writable through RetroArch
